lines.en: HELLO AGAIN MY FRIEND AGAIN I BRING AGAIN A FRIEND
lines.zh: 再次你好 我的朋友 再次 我又带来一位朋友

lines.en: a friend with tongue and limbs and tongue a friend until the very end
lines.zh: 一位有舌头有四肢还有舌头的朋友 一位陪你到底的朋友

lines.en: AND EVEN IF YOU LIE INSIDE THE MOUTH THAT BUILDS YOUR WORDS
lines.zh: 即使你躺在那副构筑你言语的嘴里

lines.en: i promise that this friend is good so good he feeds the birds
lines.zh: 我保证这位朋友很好 好到他会喂养鸟儿

lines.en: NOODLE SHOP, NOODLE SHOP\nIT’S TIME FOR ONE MORE NOODLE STOP
lines.zh: 面馆,面馆\n该再进面馆歇一站

lines.en: I decide to head over to Tojo Ramen because it’s Wednesday which starts with すい which is also what watermelon starts with and watermelons remind me of Maya (old) so I need to be around food that isn’t watermelon and there is none of that nonsense here. Hello.
lines.zh: 我决定前往 Tojo 拉面,因为今天是星期三,以「すい」开头,而西瓜也以「すい」开头,西瓜让我想起 Maya(旧版),所以我需要待在一种不是西瓜的食物旁边,而这里没有任何那种荒唐玩意。你好。

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : !!! (Hello [[translated by DeepL’s new Naogmentation])
lines.zh: : !!!(你好 [[由 DeepL 全新「Naogmentation」功能翻译])

lines.en: : Where’s Tsuneyo? Is it just you today?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 呢?今天只有你?

lines.en: : !... (ERROR [[Your free trial has expired])
lines.zh: : !...(错误 [[你的免费试用期已结束])

lines.en: : What are you drawing this time? I bet it’s completely normal and not at all weird.
lines.zh: : 这次画的什么?我赌它完全正常,一点也不怪。

lines.en: : Oh, look. It appears that I was wrong.
lines.zh: : 哦,看。看来我错了。

lines.en: : Yes. But, that aside, can I consume that bowl of noodles if you do not want to? If it just sits there collecting dust, chances are it will get all dusty.
lines.zh: : 是的。不过撇开这个,那碗面你要是不吃,能给我吃吗?它要是搁在那儿积灰,多半会变得灰扑扑的。

lines.en: : And nobody likes DUSTY ramen.
lines.zh: : 而且没人喜欢灰扑扑的拉面。

lines.en: : If you didn’t get that, it’s because you aren’t old enough.
lines.zh: : 你要是没听懂,是因为你年纪还不够。

lines.en: Nao-chan (who believes she is old enough) kicks back a passively aggressive glare that rivals the type that appears on windows when the sun is too argumentative.
lines.zh: Nao 酱(她自认为年纪够)回敬了一记消极抵抗式的怒视,其威力堪比阳光太爱抬杠时窗户上出现的那种光。

lines.en: She thinks for a moment about the level of sanity currently present in the protagonist today and considers whether or not she should use this to her advantage to finally sleep with him.
lines.zh: 她想了一会儿男主角今天神智清醒的程度,盘算着是否该利用这一点,终于和他睡上一觉。

lines.en: She doesn’t though because she’s a good girl (like thomas tongueman) and wants her first penetrative experience to be entirely consensual and also not in a ramen shop (reasonable).
lines.zh: 不过她没有,因为她是个乖女孩(像 thomas tongueman 一样),希望自己的初次插入体验完全出于自愿,而且别发生在拉面店里(合理)。

lines.en: She also has a problem with the narrator (me) pointing this out.
lines.zh: 她对旁白(我)指出这一点,也很有意见。

lines.en: : So, I guess since Tsuneyo has taken a leave of absence to run around the top floor naked again, it’s just you and me and some dusty ramen tonight. Talk about a sooeeyowbee, am I left?
lines.zh: : 所以,既然 Tsuneyo 又请假去顶楼裸奔了,今晚就只剩你、我和一些灰扑扑的拉面。来聊聊「sooeeyowbee」吧,我没走?

lines.en: : I said “ami left?”
lines.zh: : 我说的是「Ami 走了?」

lines.en: : Tough crowd. A kind wouldn’t even be able to wear this if you switched the d to a g.
lines.zh: : 观众真难伺候。就算你把 d 换成 g,一个 kind 也穿不上这件。

lines.en: : Is it just me or did some numbers sneak in among the punctuations there?
lines.zh: : 是我的错觉,还是刚才的标点里混进了几个数字?

lines.en: : (Angry silence)
lines.zh: : (愤怒的沉默)

lines.en: (Arm emergence)
lines.zh: (手臂现身)

lines.en: : Now, Nao! Look out now! It’s an arm emergency!
lines.zh: : 现在,Nao!当心了!手臂紧急事态!

lines.en: : An armergency! You should heed this arm urgency!
lines.zh: : 一场手臂紧急事态!你应当正视这手臂的急迫!

lines.en: (I’m sorry in advance to whoever winds up translating this. And also to Tsuneyo who has to witness it from the shadowy corner since I put her in time-out.)
lines.zh: (在此先向最终要翻译这段的人道歉。也向 Tsuneyo 道歉——因为我把她关了禁闭,她只能在阴影角落里目睹这一切。)

lines.en: : Why must this always happen the moment I go on break?
lines.zh: : 为什么这种事总要发生在我刚开始休息的那一刻?

lines.en: (She’d be better off in a lake)
lines.zh: (她还不如待在湖里)

lines.en: : Oh no! The mysterious arm has dragged Nao-chan into her drawing! She has finally been written out of the game! Why couldn’t it have been me?!
lines.zh: : 哦不!神秘手臂把 Nao 酱拖进了她的画里!她终于被写出游戏了!为什么不是我?!

lines.en: : Because you still have a job to do. Now put on an apron and start making gyoza. We have a catering order to knock out before my father wakes up.
lines.zh: : 因为你还有活要干。现在系上围裙,开始包饺子。在我父亲醒来之前,我们得赶完一份外烩订单。

lines.en: : Help! The hand is me now!
lines.zh: : 救命!现在手是我了!

lines.en: : You’re wrong. The hand is all of us. For it is we who manipulate reality and not the appendigious offspring of an unlikely bloated belmach.
lines.zh: : 你错了。手是我们所有人。操纵现实的是我们,而不是某条不太可能存在的、肿胀的 belmach 的附属器官后裔。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo! Clock back in and get it off! I’ll make you as much gyoza as you want!
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo!回来打卡,把它弄掉!你要多少饺子我就给你包多少!

lines.en: : I think it would be best if you just let it take you. You have an appointment on the Great Overlook. And if Nao-chan has to handle it by herself, she might expire before the fifth chapter begins.
lines.zh: : 我觉得,你干脆顺从它把你带走比较好。你在「大远眺」有一个预约。而如果 Nao 酱不得不独自应对,她可能会在第五章开始之前就断气。

lines.en: : It tastes like belmach!
lines.zh: : 尝起来像 belmach!

lines.en: : It’s all in your head.
lines.zh: : 都是你脑补的。

lines.en: : What you taste is the menma.
lines.zh: : 你尝到的是 menma。

lines.en: Just like before, she was somewhere else. A room not meant for waiting, but one that she would wait for and in. Unlike a dream, but unlike not a dream too.
lines.zh: 和从前一样,她在另一个地方。一个并非用来等待的房间,却又是她会等待、并且身处其中的房间。不像梦,但也不像不是梦。

lines.en: They called it the Great Overlook — a meeting space for those with exaggerated features who often break when viewed from the side.
lines.zh: 他们称它为大远眺——一个为五官夸张者的聚会空间,那些人从侧面看去时常常会碎裂。

lines.en: In the days of yore and yolk, it would be used as a confection center. The Great British cookshow came here to make puff pastry and toss it from the ledge to feed the poles of tad.
lines.zh: 在往昔与蛋黄的年代,它被用作甜点中心。伟大的英国烹饪秀曾来此制作千层酥皮,并把它从岩沿抛下,去喂养 tad 之极。

lines.en: A great frog they would make. Familiar too. He looks just like you.
lines.zh: 他们做出了一只伟大的青蛙。也很眼熟。他长得就像你。

lines.en: Eyes open, my daughter. Appeal to the wet slabs of earthrock I have laid at your feet and confront those who seek to reshape you in images other than mine. You’ll get it in time.
lines.zh: 睁开眼,我的女儿。向我铺在你脚下的湿润地岩板陈情,直面那些企图以我以外的形象重塑你的人。你迟早会懂的。

lines.en: (She glances to the side and realizes she is not alone. She blames him for a split second since this only happens when he is near her, but then stops doing so because she loves him for reasons that will likely never be explained outside of DLC.)
lines.zh: (她向旁边一瞥,意识到自己并非独自一人。有那么一瞬她怪罪于他,因为这种事只在他靠近时发生,但她随即停下了这份怪罪——因为她爱他,而原因恐怕除了 DLC 永远不会有人解释。)

lines.en: (Despite all the shakes, the man doesn’t wake. He stays on the ground while he dreams of a lake.)
lines.zh: (尽管晃动连连,那男人并未醒来。他躺在地上,梦着一片湖。)

lines.en: : (Sleeps incestuously)
lines.zh: : (乱伦地入睡)

lines.en: : I wouldn’t do that if I were you.
lines.zh: : 我是你就不这么做。

lines.en: : He becomes awfully boring during moments like these. And having him awake would only detract from the real reason we’re here.
lines.zh: : 在这样的时刻,他会变得无比无聊。而且让他醒着,只会偏离我们来这里的真正目的。

lines.en: : That’s right. We’re here to see you. For each meeting with him yielded not the results needed to progress, but ones that have only prolonged the misery you face each day.
lines.zh: : 没错。我们是来见你的。因为每一次与他的会面,产出的都不是推进所需的结果,而是只会延长你每日所面对之苦难的结果。

lines.en: : No, Moyo. We can not eat her.
lines.zh: : 不行,Moyo。我们不能吃她。

lines.en: : Interesting. All this time and she still can not speak. Perhaps it’s not as much of a choice as we’ve been told.
lines.zh: : 有趣。过了这么久,她依然无法言语。也许这并不像我们被告知的那样,是一种选择。

lines.en: : If you’re curious about the reasons why we’ve summoned you here, perhaps I can shine some light on it.
lines.zh: : 如果你对被召来此处的原因感到好奇,或许我能略加说明。

lines.en: : Have you ever fallen down the stairs before, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 你以前从楼梯上摔下来过吗,Nao 酱?

lines.en: : No? Well, it’s kind of like that.
lines.zh: : 没有?嗯,差不多就是那么回事。

lines.en: : You see — God is the staircase. And you’re someone who wandered into the house uninvited in an attempt to burgle and gurgle before getting caught in a mousetrap and pushed to your death.
lines.zh: : 你看——上帝就是那道楼梯。而你,是一个不请自来闯进这栋屋子、妄图又偷又咕噜的家伙,最后被捕鼠夹夹住,被推落而死。

lines.en: : Now, you’re falling down the stairs and your left leg is broken and you can’t even scream for help because you’re an incomplete butterfly.
lines.zh: : 现在,你正从楼梯上跌落,左腿已断,连呼救都做不到——因为你是一只尚未完成变态的蝴蝶。

lines.en: : We can fix you, though. Not us, but Us. The ones who reached through your paper and realigned your chakras. You’ve always been an amazing artist. But to think you could draw Life itself.
lines.zh: : 不过,我们能修好你。不是我们,是「我们」。那些透过你的画纸伸进手来、为你重新校准脉轮的存在。你一直是一位了不起的画师。可谁能想到,你竟能画出「生命」本身。

lines.en: : Now that’s special.
lines.zh: : 那可真够特别。

lines.en: : Why do you draw the things you do, Nao-chan? What are you trying to say that a mouth could not?
lines.zh: : 你为什么画那些东西,Nao 酱?你想说的,是什么嘴巴说不出的话?

lines.en: : If the problem truly is that you haven’t learned to use your tongue, we can give you a voice. And unlike the others, there is nothing we’d ask in return.
lines.zh: : 如果问题真的在于你还没学会使用舌头,我们可以给你一个声音。而且与那些家伙不同,我们不要任何回报。

lines.en: : We could even give you two. Then, you’d be just like Thomas.
lines.zh: : 我们甚至可以给你两个。那样,你就和 Thomas 一样了。

lines.en: : He’s running around in the Spectacular Playpen now. A brand new god with a throat just like yours. Would you like me to train it?
lines.zh: : 他如今正在「壮丽围栏」里四处奔跑。一个崭新的神明,喉咙和你的一模一样。要我来训练它吗?

lines.en: : Open your mouth.
lines.zh: : 张开嘴。

lines.en: : Now now, Moyo. Let’s not get hasty.
lines.zh: : 好了好了,Moyo。别这么急。

lines.en: : This is nothing a little fish can’t handle.
lines.zh: : 这点小事,一条小鱼就能摆平。

lines.en: : SUCK IT, YOU MYSTERIOUS GIRLWHORE! LET THE SCALES OF WISDOM REPLACE YOUR UNMOVING TONGUE WITH A TAPEWORM BONDED TO VERBALITY.
lines.zh: : 吸吧,你这个神秘的小婊子!让智慧之鳞把你不动的舌头,换成一条与言语能力相连的绦虫!

lines.en: : FISH! FISH! FISH!
lines.zh: : 鱼!鱼!鱼!

lines.en: : How strange. Not a single hint of vibration.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。没有一丝振动。

lines.en: : That can’t be. I think, if anything, this girl is broken.
lines.zh: : 不可能。要我说,坏的恐怕是这个女孩。

lines.en: : Which would mean that trying to change her for the better is meaningless.
lines.zh: : 那也就意味着,试图把她变得更好,毫无意义。

lines.en: : Alas. And to think we’re the only ones rooting for your success.
lines.zh: : 唉。想想看,我们可是唯一为你加油的存在。

lines.en: : Perhaps your world is doomed after all.
lines.zh: : 也许你的世界终究是注定的。

lines.en: : Oh well. You can’t say we didn’t try.
lines.zh: : 算了。你总不能说我们没试过。

lines.en: : Well, I suppose you can’t say anything technically. But you know what I mean, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 嗯,严格来说,你什么都说不了。但我相信你懂我的意思。

lines.en: : And, in the event that you ever wish to truly contribute in ways much bigger than what you can fit on a sheet of paper, clap your hands thrice and wish us back.
lines.zh: : 还有,假如你哪天真想做出比一张纸所能容纳的更大的贡献,拍三次手,把我们许愿回来。

lines.en: : If your love for him is real, this is the only way you can truly help.
lines.zh: : 如果你对他的爱是真的,这是你真正帮得上忙的唯一方式。

lines.en: : Until we meet again...Nao-chan.
lines.zh: : 后会有期……Nao 酱。

lines.en: Seeing as the man would still not wake up, Nao-chan did what any rational girl of her age would do and crawled into his arms to take a nap.
lines.zh: 眼看那男人还是不肯醒,Nao 酱做了任何她这个年纪的理性女孩都会做的事:爬进他怀里,打了个盹。

lines.en: She figured that, in the event that one of them was teleported back to earth or wherever it was they lived, they had a better chance of being teleported there together if they were touching.
lines.zh: 她想,万一他们中的一个被传送回地球、或者随便他们住的什么地方,只要两人贴在一起,被一起传送回去的概率会更大。

lines.en: And again, despite how much she wanted to be touching in a significantly more sexual manner, she was good. Like Thomas. Like menma. (I don’t like menma).
lines.zh: 再一次,尽管她无比渴望以一种刺激性欲得多的方式贴在一起,她还是乖的。像 Thomas。像 menma。(我不喜欢 menma。)

lines.en: Once his arm was properly manipulated and she was snugly pressed into his chest, she closed her eyes and attempted to rid her mind of the taste of the fish of wisdom.
lines.zh: 等他的手臂被妥当摆布、她被紧紧按进他胸口之后,她闭上眼,试图把「智慧之鱼」的味道从脑中赶走。

lines.en: And she succeeded. For her heart was now racing and the fish no longer meant anything to her at all. Nothing did. Just now and Nao and now Nao and him and Him.
lines.zh: 她成功了。因为她的心此刻狂跳不止,那条鱼已不再对她有任何意义。什么都不再有。只有此刻,和 Nao,和此刻,和 Nao,和他,和「他」。

lines.en: Him?
lines.zh: 他?

lines.en: Which one do I mean?
lines.zh: 我说的是哪一个?

lines.en: The placement ruins it all.
lines.zh: 排版毁了一切。

lines.en: Sleep, girl.
lines.zh: 睡吧,女孩。

lines.en: Dream, girl.
lines.zh: 做梦吧,女孩。

lines.en: Be, girl.
lines.zh: 存在吧,女孩。

lines.en: And when you run out of things in this life that make sense, remember just how finite the amount always was.
lines.zh: 而当你这辈子讲得通的东西用尽时,记住,那份储备从来就那么有限。

lines.en: Ignore the noise.
lines.zh: 无视那噪音。

lines.en: Be more like me.
lines.zh: 多学学我。

lines.en: My daughter.
lines.zh: 我的女儿。

lines.en: My sun.
lines.zh: 我的太阳。

lines.en: Nao’s affection has increased to [nao_love]!
lines.zh: Nao 的好感度提升到了 [nao_love]!
